items.title: Harry Shields Interview, 1961-05-28
items.q: Teddy Hart was always out there too

ctx.x: Donald Coleman, he was the president of the Times-Picay Union, right? Right, right. That's right. And, uh... What did he play? Violin. Oh, yeah. Oh, yeah.

And, uh, we used to have little... We used to go out to Charlie Leach's house when he lived out on Harmony, near Britannia. Ah. And, uh, Teddy Hart was always out there too, and, uh, Frank Mackey. Red Mackey? Red, yeah, Red Mackey. And we'd always...
Red was in everything in music, wasn't he?
